title: Projects, Tasks & Sprints
description: Projects with tasks, two-week sprints, points rollups and a live sprint dashboard.
forWho: Software and product teams working in sprints

spec.useCase: Dana Okonkwo-Reyes manages a six-person product team and uses this to see what is in the sprint, what is blocked and how many points each sprint really finishes.

text.text: Plan work in projects, break it into tasks, and pull tasks into two-week sprints. Open a sprint to see what the team committed to and how much got done.
Run this in the first hour of every sprint. The goal is a commitment the team believes in, not a full board.
